description: This file defines key enums, data classes, and utility functions used to handle data flow within a benchmarking framework for PyTorch, including benchmark configuration, model setup, and variant management.

classes.name: RuntimeMode
classes.description: Enumeration of runtime modes: Eager, TorchScript, and Explicit.

classes.name: AutogradMode
classes.description: Enumeration of autograd modes: Forward, Forward+Backward, and Explicit.

classes.name: AutoLabels
classes.description: Dataclass representing labels inferred during unpacking, including runtime, autograd, and language modes.

classes.name: GroupedSetup
classes.description: Dataclass for grouping setup code snippets for Python, C++, and global setup.

classes.name: GroupedBenchmark
classes.description: Base class representing a group of benchmarks; includes methods for initialization from statements, models, and variants.

methods.name: AutoLabels.as_dict
methods.description: Returns a dictionary representation of AutoLabels for CI reporting.

methods.name: GroupedBenchmark.init_from_model
methods.description: Creates benchmark groups based on torch.nn module setup code.

methods.name: GroupedBenchmark.init_from_variants
methods.description: Creates multiple benchmark variants from provided code blocks.

methods.name: GroupedBenchmark._parse_signature
methods.description: Parses a function signature string into arguments and output.

methods.name: GroupedBenchmark._model_from_py_stmt
methods.description: Generates a model definition function from a Python statement.

methods.name: GroupedBenchmark._make_model_invocation
methods.description: Creates invocation strings for models in Python and C++ based on signature args.

methods.name: GroupedBenchmark._parse_variants
methods.description: Parses code blocks into labeled variants and setup snippets.

methods.name: GroupedStmts
methods.description: Alias for creating benchmark groups from statements.
